title: How to Turn Any Fraction Into a Percentage
description: A simple visual trick for converting fractions like 1/5 into percentages, built for absolute beginners.
narration_lines: How do you turn a fraction into a percent?
Split the whole into 5 equal parts.
Just 1 of those 5 parts is filled in.
That's 20 percent. Divide 100 by the bottom number.
